disagreements.their_reason: The falsifier is any append changing a fitted artifact, but the scope admits only appends already verified byte-identical, excluding every failure.
The falsifier is no improvement on identically processed edits with an unchanged head; differing edit and ambiguity counts plus no supplied head fingerprint leave that open.
The falsifier is refusal changing with count while maximum cosine is fixed; the confusable arm does exactly that, falling from 0.8485 to 0.7758.
The falsifier is the gap resuming its decline beyond 18 aliases; no measurements beyond 18 rule that out, so the residual cannot yet be assigned to capability.
The falsifier is non-disjoint quorum flag sets; the supplied artifact does not provide both quorum sets, and verification flagging 0/14 contradicts the claimed verification-only item.

1.reason: The falsifiers are a larger depth-1 entity penalty or a depth-2 penalty below 0.10; the scoped measurements rule both out.

2.reason: The falsifier is any refused question remaining refused or becoming wrong, or any fingerprint changing; neither occurs.

5.reason: The falsifier is a depth-2 held-out-versus-trained gap exceeding 0.02; the measured gap is 0.011.

6.reason: The falsifier is model-only planning reaching the walker interval or store-filtered planning missing it; the scoped corpus shows neither.

7.reason: The falsifier is zero-shot 3-hop answering trailing trained 3-hop by more than 0.15; the measured deficit is about 0.112.

8.reason: The falsifier is increased wrongness at either depth or a refusal gain smaller than correct-answer loss; the reported arms rule both out.

9.reason: The falsifier is refusal changing with count while maximum cosine is fixed; the confusable arm does exactly that, falling from 0.8485 to 0.7758.

10.reason: The falsifier is wrongness growth comparable to the novel-answering gain or disappearance of refusal loss under matched coverage; measured changes rule both out.

11.reason: The falsifier is the gap resuming its decline beyond 18 aliases; no measurements beyond 18 rule that out, so the residual cannot yet be assigned to capability.

12.reason: The falsifier is non-disjoint quorum flag sets; the supplied artifact does not provide both quorum sets, and verification flagging 0/14 contradicts the claimed verification-only item.

13.reason: The falsifier is a head gap over 0.05 on any scoped population; all three measured gaps stay below it while retrieval drops sharply.
